when: 2026-09-24, after the confirmation records were fetched and embedded and before any confirmation query was scored
why: exploration after the gates in gates.json (test set already read) found that stage 2 removes information the frozen reader holds: the released OpenTSLM LoRA with a stage-1 adapter and no stage 2, read by a linear probe, gained +0.040 (0.025 to 0.055) from own history on test where the stage-2 reader gained +0.018; since test was reused for that exploration, the claim is confirmed here on subjects never used
confirmation set: bucket 1 subjects that no other role uses, drawn with the rules of every other role (scripts/select_queries.py), 200 queries per (finding, cell), 3,200 queries
reader: released OpenTSLM LoRA (OpenTSLM/llama-3.2-1b-ecg-sp) with the stage-1 adapter of seeds 0, 1 and 2, no stage 2; hidden state after layer 12 at 'Answer:' (layer 12 was chosen after looking at test; layers 8 and 16 gave per-seed gains of +0.033 to +0.048 there)
readout: per finding, standardised logistic regression; C from {1e-4, 3e-4, 1e-3, 3e-3, 1e-2} by 5-fold stratified cross-validation (random_state 0) on the 8,000 training queries' features of the same arm, maximising AUROC within current state; S-swap is scored with the S-own probe; p = predicted probability (scripts/probe.py)
metric: mean AUROC within the 8 strata (finding x current state), seed-averaged p
interval: 95 %, SE_tot^2 = SE_boot^2 + Var(per-seed contrasts)/n_seeds; bootstrap within the 16 cells, B = 2000, seed 0
C1: probe-S-own minus probe-S-swap: interval above 0 and every per-seed contrast above 0 (as G1)
C2: probe-S-own minus probe-S-none >= tau, interval above 0, every per-seed contrast above 0, and L = (S-own - S-swap) - 2/3 (S-own - S-none) >= 0 (as G2)
reported, not gated: the stage-2 readers on the same queries (S-none, S-own, S-swap; scripts/evaluate.py seed confirm) and probe minus stage-2 contrasts
